text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Kiseki enjoying
a game of poker with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mmh-co wa... Not bad at all.
Just two cards swapped for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go all in♪
Judging by Kura-chan's state, a mediocre hand won't cut it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-All of it?
Umm... Then I guess I'll, hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amid the distinct motives of the three contenders,
Kiseki kept her eyes firmly closed.
Just what could she be thinking...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"What matters in poker is not luck.
Is it, then, the sheer nerve to pull off a bluff that speaks?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text: “The answer is no—”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"'Probability calculation'...! 
This is what truly decides victory or defeat!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Just from the cards in my own hand,
I can tell which melds are hard for the other three to make.
Factoring that in, I can deduce quite a bit!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I know their personalities inside and out.
Poker is a high-level psychological war, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"First is her! Satono Crown.
A champion of the royal road who maintains
a poker face at all times...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"However, that makes it all the easier to read!
The strength of a hand is inversely proportional to their attitude!
That confident look is eight-or-nine-to-one a bluff!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text: "And then there's Satono Diamond. As someone who loves a challenge, she tends to make daring moves. If there's an opening to exploit, that's where it lies."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Think...! That tone of hers...
She definitely didn't have a bust hand."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Without enough data,
further deduction is impossible.
However, what we can deduce from this is...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"She's not acting on logic!
She's defying fate... once again!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, there is no need for undue caution.
While they may pull off immense luck,
worrying about it will only drain our mental stamina."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"And finally, the dark horse, Cheval Grand.
To tell the truth, the one I'm on guard against
more than anyone else is her."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"She is likely just like me.
A competitor whose primary weapon is probability calculation.
Furthermore, she possesses a terrifyingly formidable unique skill."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That's a natural-born 'stealth'...!
It's not an act; her lack of confidence
leads others to misjudge the hand she truly holds...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“After all, it is entirely possible that Cheval Grand held the best hand right from the very first move.
In that case, the entire situation will be turned completely on its head.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"What'll it be?
Swap, or fold altogether?
Sink or swim...!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"—so Kiseki pondered.
All within the span of a mere 0.6 seconds..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-About two minutes have passed, though...!?
Plus, I'm pretty sure you said all that out loud...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it really is just like a shonen manga...
*Giggle*...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm starting to get fired up too!
I want to have a super heated battle!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah. For a second I wondered if I should back down, but hearing that makes me want to take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's what I'm talking about!
Here we go, the battle continues---!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah--!
'A miraculous hand, a proper discard.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, everyone has finished exchanging cards.
Not a single person has folded.
Just who will emerge victorious... or defeated...?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Both Kiseki-san and I have four of a kind...!
But Kiseki-san's number is higher.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...!
Looks like I win!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wah! You really did it, huh.
Winning by a razor-thin margin, just like a true hero.
Fufufufu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And all four burst out laughing. Thanks to Kiseki's manga filter (?), things really seemed to liven up!
choice_data_list: They're a tough bunch of rivals.
They're a tough bunch of rivals, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And all four burst out laughing. Thanks to Kiseki's manga filter (?), things really seemed to liven up!
choice_data_list: They're a tough bunch of rivals.
They're a tough bunch of rivals, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
That win just now was so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
High-level psychological warfare...
The guts to step in right when it counts...!
Nnnngh~~! That's hot! Way too hot!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To make a match interesting,
the way you win is what's important!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
They are such charming, colorful rivals!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And the super cool protagonist who takes it down
is none other than me!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The higher the wall, the cooler it is, right?!
Heheh, I won't lose in the race either! ♪"
